slides.header: How long does an Oregon roof actually last?

slides.body: Most asphalt shingle roofs in western Oregon last 20 to 30 years. Architectural shingles installed to spec and maintained sit at the top of that range.

slides.header: Oregon roofs don't die of sunburn
slides.body: We're easy on shingles when it comes to hail and extreme heat. Roofs here die of moisture: moss, debris, trapped water, and wind working at the edges.
Moss left to establish, clogged gutters, poor attic ventilation, rushed installation, and pressure washing. One aggressive cleaning can take years off.
Regular cleaning and moss treatment, clear valleys and gutters, healthy ventilation, and small repairs handled while they're small. Boring and predictable, the best kind of list.
Good light and dry shingles make this the easiest time of year to see your roof clearly. Look for granules in gutters, patchy color loss, and curling edges.
